_comment: Rotation order = array order. Every on-screen/spoken claim must appear in `claims` with codebase evidence. Crops are in source pixels of the 2560x1440 captures (h is derived from the card aspect). `existing_audio` (optional) maps segments to pre-existing narration files; it is only used with --audio existing and is labelled as reused, never as newly generated.
